algorithms.description: Hash algorithms to compute. Valid values: md5, sha1, sha256, tiger, whirlpool.

known_hashes.description: List of paths to files containing known hashes (for -k).

files_list.description: Path to file containing list of files to hash (-f).

show_hash.description: Show hash values in matching mode (-M/-X).

case_insensitive_audit.description: Case-insensitive filename matching in audit mode (-E).

size_threshold.description: Size threshold (IEC suffixes: b,k,m,g,t,p,e) for file selection (-i).

output_modes.description: File type selection for expert mode: f,b,c,p,l,s,d,e. Must be empty or subset of valid characters.

piecewise_chunk_size.description: Chunk size for piecewise mode (IEC suffixes).

bare_mode.description: Strip leading directory info from filenames (-b).

relative_paths.description: Output relative paths instead of absolute (-l).

verbose.description: Verbose level for audit (0 = default, 1 = summary, 2 = discrepancies, 3 = per-file details).

threads.description: Thread count: 0 for auto (one per CPU), -j0 disables multithreading.
